title: 3 Conflict Types
summary: Apply orchestration patterns, configure parallel isolation, detect and resolve conflicts, manage agent lifecycles, and implement recovery in multi-agent workflows.

rows: Two agents modify same file/region simultaneously
Agents A and B both edit auth.ts → merge conflict
Two agents independently solve the same problem
Both implement the same utility function
A uses class-based, B uses functional for same module

blocks.text: **Detection Point:** Conflicts must be caught at the integration step BEFORE merging — by comparing artifacts. Agents cannot reliably self-detect each other's conflicts.
